lines.t: He has put forth a multitude of words to bless you,
A great host of loving and stern speeches.
He has called this generation to turn,
And has given warning, clear and ample.
Those who cupped their ears have heard His voice,
Those who received of Him have written His words
Upon the table of their hearts in truth,
That they might honor Him and bring glory to His name.
There is but One… One Escape, One Salvation…
No matter the time, no matter the nation…
There is but One… One Escape, One Salvation…
He has stretched out His hand to a wayward people,
Yet few turn to Him in sincerity.
His mercy still calls in the wilderness,
His voice still walks upon the wind.
Blessed are those who humble themselves,
Who walk in the light He has given them.
For in obedience, they shall find rest,
And in repentance, they shall find peace.
There is but One… One Escape, One Salvation…
No matter the time, no matter the nation…
There is but One… One Escape, One Salvation…
Let the proud be made low,
Let the meek lift up their eyes.
For He has spoken, and it shall stand,
He has declared, and it shall surely be.
He is the Beginning and the End,
The Door, the Way, the Breath of Life.
There is but One… One Escape, One Salvation…
No matter the time, no matter the nation…
There is but One… One Escape, One Salvation…
